definitions.gloss: regular mail; standard mail; ordinary mail
definitions.explanation: The basic postal delivery service without tracking, insurance, or special handling. The most common and least expensive way to send letters and small packages.

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is it okay to send it by regular mail?

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧、{三日|さんにち}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: With regular mail, it takes two or three days to arrive.

examples.japanese: {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{追跡|ついせき}→追跡：09722_tsuiseki⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できない→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Regular mail doesn't have tracking service, so you can't confirm whether it arrived.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ (ordinary, regular) and ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ (mail, postal service). The default postal service for everyday correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ — to send by regular mail
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ — regular mail postage
- {普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧ — delivery days for regular mail

CHARACTERISTICS:
- No tracking number
- No compensation if lost
- Delivered to the mailbox (no signature required)
- Cheapest option
- Cannot be used to send cash

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{書留|かきとめ}→書留：00150_kakitome⟧ — registered mail (tracked and insured)
- ⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧ — express delivery (faster but more expensive)
- {定形郵便|ていけいゆうびん} — standard-size mail (fits specific size/weight limits)
- {定形外郵便|ていけいがいゆうびん} — non-standard-size mail (oversized or overweight items)
- ⟦{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}→配達証明：25813_haitatsushoumei⟧ — delivery certification

PRACTICAL NOTE:
{普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん} can be posted simply by affixing the correct postage stamp and dropping it in a mailbox (⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧). No visit to the post office is needed for standard-size items.
